title: Compost the plan
summary: Look for reusable pieces in a stalled project before deciding whether the whole thing needs to return.
revive_when: An old project has one lovely idea buried under five things you no longer want to maintain.

related.reason: Reusing a fragment gives collecting a purpose without making every saved project a commitment.
A connection to a different problem often reveals which fragment is worth reusing.

origin: Original starter reflection written for the collection.
